_comment: REFERENCE DOCUMENTATION ONLY - THIS FILE IS NOT ENFORCED. Nothing loads it: validate_config_schema() in script/validation_module.R checks only that six top-level sections are present, and this file is not even COPYed into the Docker image. It had drifted badly from the code (output_files, cell_type_annotation and export_loupe were absent entirely; add_metadata was missing 7 keys; aggregation.assays was missing). It has been brought back in line with what orchestrator.R actually reads, but keep in mind that a typo in a config will NOT be caught here. Wiring this up with jsonvalidate is tracked separately - it would reject configs that currently run, so it needs a deliberate decision.
title: T cell Workflow Configuration

rna_path.description: Path to RNA matrix (H5AD, H5, RDS, CSV)

top_mouse_genes.description: Number of top-expressed genes checked when inferring species from the matrix

rds_rna_key.description: List element name holding the RNA matrix when loading a .rds list

rds_adt_key.description: List element name holding the ADT matrix when loading a .rds list

join_layers.description: Join per-sample v5 layers into a single counts layer after loading a directory of .rds files

sheet.description: Worksheet name or index in the metadata workbook.

col_types.description: Per-column type overrides passed to the reader.

na_values.description: Extra strings to treat as NA.

overwrite_existing.description: Overwrite metadata columns that already exist on the object.

subset_to_existing.description: Keep only cells that match a metadata row.

add_match_status.description: Add a column recording whether each cell matched a metadata row.

backup_metadata.description: Snapshot the original meta.data before merging, so it can be restored.

adt_method.description: NOT READ BY THE PIPELINE. ADT normalisation is chosen inside .normalize_adt() (CLR, or ADTnorm when batch correction is enabled); only normalization.rna_method is consumed. Retained for reference; setting it has no effect.

doublets.description: Doublet detection and removal. Detection runs per capture (scDblFinder on RNA) with an optional ADT cross-lineage confirmation, after cell/gene QC and before normalisation, batch correction and clustering.

remove.description: Remove detected doublets, as for other QC filters. When false they are flagged in metadata and retained.

sample_column.description: Metadata column identifying the capture/library. Detection is run separately per capture. Falls back to batch.column, then orig.ident.

use_adt.description: Use the ADT cross-lineage co-expression signature as a confirmatory signal on CITE-seq data

adt_quantile.description: Per-marker upper-tail quantile defining ADT positivity for the cross-lineage check

min_cells.description: Minimum cells for a capture to be classified

use_sketch.description: Force sketch mode. null = auto (enabled at >= 850,000 cells).

sketch_ncells.description: Cells to retain in the sketch. null = 40% of total.

remove_ids.description: orig.ident values to drop before QC

assays.description: Assays to aggregate into the pseudobulk matrix.

batch.description: Batch effect detection and correction settings

detect.description: Run batch effect detection metrics (LISI, silhouette, Wasserstein)

correct.description: Correction control for BOTH modalities: 'auto' corrects when detection flags it; true forces; false disables. Overridden per-modality by correct_rna / correct_adt.

correct_rna.description: RNA-only correction control ('auto'/true/false). Falls back to 'correct' when omitted.

correct_adt.description: ADT-only correction control ('auto'/true/false). Falls back to 'correct' when omitted.

lisi_threshold.description: Fraction of n_batches below which median iLISI triggers the batch flag

silhouette_threshold.description: Mean silhouette width above which the batch flag is set

silhouette_n_cells.description: Max cells to subsample for silhouette computation (O(n^2) memory)

wasserstein_threshold.description: Per-protein mean Wasserstein distance above which a protein is flagged

min_cells_per_batch.description: Minimum cells per batch for reliable detection

adt_correction_method.description: HOW ADT batch correction is applied when detection (or forcing) says it should run: 'harmony' corrects the apca embedding (marker values untouched), 'adtnorm' corrects the CLR data layer, 'none' disables ADT correction even when recommended.

adt_kbet_threshold.description: kBET rejection rate on the provisional ADT PCA above which the ADT batch flag is set during detection.

adt_guardrail_min_improvement.description: Minimum drop in kBET rejection (before - after) for a correction to be ADOPTED; otherwise it is reverted and the object keeps the uncorrected ADT.

output_files.description: Per-step output filenames. Every key is optional; orchestrator.R falls back to '<step>.rds'.

load_data.description: Filename for the load_data step output.

add_metadata.description: Filename for the add_metadata step output.

process_seurat.description: Filename for the process_seurat step output. Its basename is also used as output_prefix for QC side-files.

cell_type_annotation.description: Filename for the cell_type_annotation step output.

aggregate_ml.description: Filename for the aggregate_ml workbook; any extension is normalised to .xlsx.

cell_type_annotation.description: Cell-type annotation step. All keys optional; defaults shown are applied in orchestrator.R.

singler_workers.description: Parallel workers for SingleR; defaults to execution.n_cores.

stcat_python_script.description: Path to a custom STCAT driver script.

stcat_batch_column.description: Metadata column identifying batches for the T-subset re-embedding sent to STCAT; more than one level triggers Harmony correction of that embedding. Falls back to batch.column.

singler_fine_chunk_size.description: Cells per chunk in the per-cell SingleR fine annotation pass. Memory scales with the chunk, not the dataset.

prefix.description: Prefix prepended to annotation column names.

fallback_column.description: Column used when a cell has no confident call.

export_loupe.description: Loupe browser export step. Requires the loupeR package; validate_step_requirements() checks this up front.

source_step.description: Step whose .rds is exported. Must be a single-cell object, not the pseudobulk aggregate.

output_name.description: Base name for the .cloupe file; a run timestamp is appended.

executable_path.description: Explicit path to the louper executable if not auto-discovered.
